name: Add disk
description: Add disk Attach a persistent disk to a web service, private service, or background worker. POST /v1/disks
context:
POST /v1/disks
Attach a persistent disk to a web service, private service, or background worker. The service must be redeployed for the disk to be attached.
Required: body (body)

name: Delete disk
description: Delete disk Delete a persistent disk attached to a service. DELETE /v1/disks/{diskId}

name: List disks
description: List disks List persistent disks matching the provided filters. GET /v1/disks
context:
GET /v1/disks
List persistent disks matching the provided filters. If no filters are provided, returns all disks you have permissions to view.
Optional: ownerId (query) — The ID of the workspaces to return resources for; diskId (query) — Filter by disk IDs; name (query) — Filter by name; createdBefore (query) — Filter for resources created before a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp); createdAfter (query) — Filter for resources created after a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp); updatedBefore (query) — Filter for resources updated before a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp); updatedAfter (query) — Filter for resources updated after a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp); serviceId (query) — Filter for resources by service ID; cursor (query) — The position in the result list to start from when fetching paginated results. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).; limit (query) — The maximum number of items to return. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).

name: List snapshots
description: List snapshots List snapshots for the persistent disk with the provided ID. GET /v1/disks/{diskId}/snapshots
context:
GET /v1/disks/{diskId}/snapshots
List snapshots for the persistent disk with the provided ID. Each snapshot is a point-in-time copy of the disk's data.
Required: diskId (path) — The ID of the disk

name: Restore snapshot
description: Restore snapshot Restore a persistent disk to an available snapshot. POST /v1/disks/{diskId}/snapshots/restore
context:
POST /v1/disks/{diskId}/snapshots/restore
Restore a persistent disk to an available snapshot. **This operation is irreversible.** It will overwrite the current disk data. It might also trigger a service deploy. Snapshot keys returned from the [List snapshots](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/list-snapshots) endpoint expire after 24 hours. If a snapshot key has expired, query the endpoint again for a new key.
Required: diskId (path) — The ID of the disk; body (body)

name: Retrieve disk
description: Retrieve disk Retrieve the persistent disk with the provided ID. GET /v1/disks/{diskId}

name: Update disk
description: Update disk Update the persistent disk with the provided ID. PATCH /v1/disks/{diskId}
